assumptions: Local DRAM and CXL values are starting presets from docs/HARDWARE-MODELS.md, not measurements of a specific machine.
Each compute-to-pool link is modeled as an independent byte server; shared pool service contention is not yet modeled in this revision.
The workload is synthetic KV-cache decode derived from Llama-3-70B geometry. It is not a captured serving trace.
Results are relative comparisons between policies until the scenario is calibrated against measured latency distributions.
description: Four compute nodes serving Llama-3-70B with a shared CXL-attached memory pool. Compares a hot/cold placement policy against local-only and swap baselines.
